title: Images and video sized for phones and data saver
when: Phone users download huge photos or autoplay videos on mobile data, or portrait screens crop the important part of wide images.
prompt: Goal: Media that loads only what a phone screen shows, crops well in portrait and respects data saver. Steps: 1. Cap pixel density at 2x: a 360 px wide slot needs at most a 720 px image; skip 3x files. 2. Art direction with : for a portrait crop, then the wide as default. 3. Every gets width, height, alt, decoding="async" and loading="lazy", except the first visible image, which gets fetchpriority="high" and no lazy. 4. Video:

examples.input: as fotos do meu site pesam muito no 4G
examples.output: picture with portrait crop, 2x cap, lazy below fold, playsinline posters, saveData swap
